tools.name: climate_by_month
tools.description: Returns the 12 monthly climate averages (high and low °C, rain mm, rain days, cloud %, humidity %) for one place among about 100 digital nomad bases worldwide.

tools.name: best_months
tools.description: Returns the top 3 months for dry, warm, cool, sunny or clean-air weather in one place among about 100 digital nomad bases worldwide, with the numbers and the rule used.

tools.name: smoke_by_month
tools.description: Returns the 12 monthly PM2.5 air-quality averages and their bands (clear, hazy, smoky, very smoky) for 20 nomad bases in Asia and Mexico, such as Chiang Mai, Hanoi and Bangkok.
